Container.Name: boomarr
Container.Overview: Symlink-based audio language filter for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. Boomarr mirrors your media library into separate folders that only contain files with the audio languages you want (e.g. a German-only library for family members). No files are copied or modified.[br][br]IMPORTANT: Map your media share to the SAME container path that Plex/Jellyfin uses (e.g. /data), map it READ-ONLY, and edit /config/boomarr.yml after the first start.
Container.Requires: The media share must be mapped read-only and at the same container path your media server uses, otherwise the symlinks will not resolve inside Plex/Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Config file (boomarr.yml), probe cache and logs.

Config.Name: Media (read-only)
Config.Description: Your media library. MUST be read-only and use the same container path as in Plex/Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Filtered output
Config.Description: Where the filtered symlink libraries are created. Map it into Plex/Jellyfin at the same container path.

Config.Name: Webhook port
Config.Description: Only needed when the webhook trigger is enabled in boomarr.yml (Sonarr/Radarr instant rescans).

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warning, error or critical.

Config.Name: Webhook API key
Config.Description: Shared secret for the webhook trigger (used when api_key is not set in boomarr.yml).
